newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu-Kabila talks on Zaire postponed to Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu-Kabila talks on Zaire postponed to Saturday.

text.p: Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seka postponed his scheduled departure to Libreville, Gabon, on Thursday and officials said they understood his fateful encounter with rebel leader Laurent Kabila had been put back a day from Friday to Saturday.

"The president is not leaving and the journey is cancelled for today. This is not Zaire's decision and there's no health reason but we understand the talks have been postponed until Saturday," Information Minister Kin-Kiey Mulumba told Reuters in Kinshasa.
